properties.Description:
Construction of a Tank

Site preparation & setting out

Earth excavation for foundation or quarry materials and haul the surplus materials up to 30m by Manually.

150mm x 225mm Random Rubble masonry work in 1:5 cement and sand mortar in structure

Plaster 12mm thick in 1:3 cement and sand finished smooth with gray cement floating

Fabricating & fixing security weld mesh in open type buildings in GI weld mesh 50mm x 50mm SWG 10, welded on 40mm x 40mm x 5mm angle frame complete with application of two coats enamel paint over two coats of anticorrosive paint and complete. All as per detail drawing No.CPC/CS/11/04/2017/TYPE‐ST/07

Tidying up

Vegetative cover improving around the spring (5m x 10m) with Areca nut seedling in 1.5m x 1.5m grid, Kumbuk/ Mee/ Godapara/ Kaduru/ Aththikka/ Wal Del/ Kekuna/ randomly mixed seedlings and planting at 3.5 m x 3.5 m grid interval

Marking boundaries

Contingencies 10%
